verdict.rationale: The evidence names Extend Studio as a product surface (pricing lists "Studio and Evals"), described as where processors are versioned and iterated on. That suggests a web UI for testing document processing before integrating, but nothing explicitly describes uploading or dragging a document and viewing parse/extract output without code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a drag-and-drop web playground, a description of viewing parse/extract results in the UI, and hands-on or independent corroboration of a no-code try-before-you-code flow.
